home.title: Shield Labs
home.fit: **Core skincare, good fit — highest claim risk in the batch.** Men's acne is an under-served UGC segment with a clear before/after demo and a defined avatar. But the homepage runs a wall of BEFORE/AFTER pairs plus '271,342+ Men Cleared Their Acne in Under 6 Weeks', '97% had less acne after 6 weeks' and '37% less irritation than traditional benzoyl peroxide' — time-bound efficacy, a competitor-ingredient comparison, and acne treatment claims that sit in OTC-drug territory in the US. The trial is footnoted as double-blind and dermatologist-reviewed, so substantiation may well exist, but creative must not reuse any of it without seeing that file first.
